name: Syrup Bomb
description:
You set off an explosion of sticky candy syrup at a point within range. Each creature within 5ft of that point must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on failure, half on success. On failure, the creature also falls Prone.

Syrup then covers the ground within 5ft of the target point for the duration. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must make a {save}, falling Prone on failure.
